description: I nourish me and care for me #selfcare #selfimprovement #selflove
transcript: But I do not focus on what others think, say, or do. I focus on what I say, think, and do. And that is the most important thing. The more that I have made myself the focal point, the less judgment I have for the external world. My responsibility is to nourish my own garden. My responsibility is to take care of me. The more that I take care of my internal world, the more that I'm able to show up in my natural form in the external world. The more that I'm able to lead with my moral values, the more that I am able to sit in who I truly am. I am responsible for me.
